result.instructions: Tools for Kustomer, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the customer with the email anna@example.com and show her open conversations."; "Search for open conversations with priority 4 or higher created this week."; "Add the tag refund-requested to conversation 58228e05d4e96711004eccb7.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Kustomer data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kustomer_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kustomer_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kustomer_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. kustomer_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kustomer_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current API user
tools.description: Return the user behind the API key (a machine user) and its roles. Use it to check the key works. Kustomer API: GET /v1/users/current.

tools.name: kustomer_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List agents, admins or machine users, or find one user by email. Pass one filter at a time. Use the user ids for conversation assignments. Kustomer API: GET /v1/users.

userType.description: Filter by type: user (agent or admin), limited (collaborator) or machine (API key user).

email.description: Find the user with this email address.

tools.name: kustomer_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, with attributes, contact details and company link. Kustomer API: GET /v1/customers/{id}.

customer_id.description: The Kustomer object id (24 hex characters).

tools.name: kustomer_find_customer_by_email
tools.title: Find a customer by email
tools.description: Find a customer by email address. Kustomer API: GET /v1/customers/email={email}.

tools.name: kustomer_find_customer_by_phone
tools.title: Find a customer by phone
tools.description: Find a customer by phone number (E.164, for example +15555550123). Kustomer API: GET /v1/customers/phone={phone}.

phone.description: The phone number, ideally in E.164 format.

tools.name: kustomer_find_customer_by_external_id
tools.title: Find a customer by external id
tools.description: Find a customer by the id it has in your own system. Kustomer API: GET /v1/customers/externalId={externalId}.

external_id.description: Your system's id for the customer.

annotations.title: Find a customer by external id

tools.name: kustomer_search
tools.title: Search records
tools.description: Search customers, conversations, messages, companies or custom objects with criteria (and/or) and sort. Covers records updated in the last two years, max 10,000 results per query, 100 searches per minute per key. Kustomer API: POST /v1/customers/search.

context.description: The object type to return. Use conversation to list conversations.

and.description: Criteria objects such as {"conversation_status": {"equals": "open"}}. Attribute names are <object>_<attribute>.

or.description: Criteria objects such as {"conversation_status": {"equals": "open"}}. Attribute names are <object>_<attribute>.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for local dates, for example America/New_York.

tools.name: kustomer_list_customer_conversations
tools.title: List a customer's conversations
tools.description: List the conversations of one customer, newest first. Kustomer API: GET /v1/customers/{id}/conversations.

customer_id.description: The Kustomer object id (24 hex characters).

tools.name: kustomer_get_customer_notes
tools.title: List a customer's notes
tools.description: List the internal notes on one customer. Kustomer API: GET /v1/customers/{id}/notes.

customer_id.description: The Kustomer object id (24 hex characters).

tools.name: kustomer_get_conversation
tools.title: Get a conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation by id: status, assignees, tags, priority and counters. Kustomer API: GET /v1/conversations/{id}.

conversation_id.description: The Kustomer object id (24 hex characters).

tools.name: kustomer_get_conversation_messages
tools.title: List conversation messages
tools.description: List the messages of one conversation (email, chat, SMS, and others) with direction and preview text. Kustomer API: GET /v1/conversations/{id}/messages.

conversation_id.description: The Kustomer object id (24 hex characters).

tools.name: kustomer_get_conversation_notes
tools.title: List conversation notes
tools.description: List the internal notes on one conversation. Kustomer API: GET /v1/conversations/{id}/notes.

conversation_id.description: The Kustomer object id (24 hex characters).

tools.name: kustomer_get_company
tools.title: Get a company
tools.description: Get one company by id, with its attributes. Kustomer API: GET /v1/companies/{id}.

company_id.description: The Kustomer object id (24 hex characters).

tools.name: kustomer_add_conversation_note
tools.title: Add a note to a conversation
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a conversation. The customer does not see it. Text up to 10,240 characters. Kustomer API: POST /v1/conversations/{id}/notes.

conversation_id.description: The Kustomer object id (24 hex characters).

annotations.title: Add a note to a conversation

tools.name: kustomer_add_conversation_tags
tools.title: Add tags to a conversation
tools.description: WRITE: add tags to a conversation. Missing tags are created in the org. Other tags stay. Kustomer API: POST /v1/conversations/{id}/tags.

conversation_id.description: The Kustomer object id (24 hex characters).

tools.name: kustomer_remove_conversation_tags
tools.title: Remove tags from a conversation
tools.description: WRITE: remove tags from a conversation. Other tags stay. Kustomer API: DELETE /v1/conversations/{id}/tags.

conversation_id.description: The Kustomer object id (24 hex characters).
